focus_areas: Texture consistency of the yellow disc florets
Edge sharpness and separation of white petals
Natural variation in petal shape and arrangement

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition between the yellow disc and white petals. AI often blurs this boundary or creates irregular, non-biological patterns in the disc florets. Verify if the petal arrangement follows a natural phyllotaxis or if it looks randomly generated/warped.
image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a single daisy flower head. The image is dominated by the bright yellow central disc composed of tightly packed disc florets and the surrounding white ray petals (florets). A small portion of green sepals or leaves is visible peeking out from behind the petals near the center. The background is dark and out of focus.
